description: Exact findings excerpt from authentic protected admission review; full receipt remains in protected audit custody. This was a changes-required decision, not an approval.
head: a39b286c6ac3190ebd3610cf73c58199312a6c08
findings: The proposed issuer gate does not bind the reviewer's execution to the files checked by root. In v56-history-v2.patch, guarded_preflight.preflight opens the launcher under the issuer's absolute staging directory, while review_protocol_v2.INNER uses relative paths for the launcher, package, review input and archive. validate_v2_history checks command text, exit status and a proof line, but checks neither the command's working directory nor the identity of the files opened by the reviewer. The proof is computable from the reviewer's readable token and archive. Both root preflights can therefore agree while the accepted trace refers to a different directory. The retained successful trace demonstrates the intended invocation but does not establish the required same-file binding.

The v2 verifier can accept an inherited coverage snapshot whose frozen source manifest has changed. In solid_history_v2.py and the pinned verifier, the base_paths comparison protects the inherited snapshot's mode and blob. The next check requires manifest['snapshots'] to contain exactly the newly added paths. Both the scoped source checks and verify_projection's historical source-blob comparison then iterate only those new associations. A candidate that adds a valid new snapshot and changes a source manifest referenced only by an inherited snapshot passes these continuity checks. The inherited snapshot still names the same source path, but resolving it at head yields different inputs. This contradicts the artifact's stated preservation of frozen snapshot/source associations.
